app.name: Handover
login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your email and password to access your account.
login.tagline: A website owner's manual generator for agencies
login.signupDescription: Start generating client manuals in minutes.
login.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
login.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
login.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
login.signupError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.alreadyRegistered: That email may already have an account. Try signing in instead.
login.checkEmail: Check your email — we've sent a confirmation link to:
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
reset.sent: If that address has an account, we've sent a reset link. Check your email.
reset.setNewPasswordDescription: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.updateError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
reset.expiredDescription: This password reset link is no longer valid.
reset.expiredMessage: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one and we'll send a fresh link to your email.
manuals.title: Manuals
manuals.subtitle: {agency} — your client manuals
manuals.limitDescription: You can create one manual on the free plan. Upgrade to create unlimited manuals.
manuals.emptyDescription: Create your first client manual. You'll fill in the details, and we'll generate a professional document your client can read and print.
manuals.linkCopiedDesc: The public URL is in your clipboard.
manuals.newDialog.title: New manual
manuals.newDialog.clientNameHelp: This becomes the manual's title. You can change it later.
manuals.draftWarn.title: This manual is a draft
manuals.draftWarn.body: This manual is only {percent}% complete. Sharing it now means your client will see a manual with missing information. Are you sure you want to open it?
settings.title: Agency Settings
settings.subtitle: This branding appears on every client manual you generate. Set it up once.
settings.identityDescription: Your agency's name and logo as they appear on manuals.
settings.agencyWebsiteHelp: Your logo links here on every manual you publish.
settings.logoUrlSchemeError: Logo URLs must start with https:// — an insecure image won't display on your client's manual.
settings.brandColorDescription: Used for headings and accents on the manual. Choose a color that matches your brand.
settings.previewBody: Headings and accents will use this color.
settings.supportDescription: How clients should reach you for day-to-day support and emergencies.
settings.emergencyPhoneHelp: For urgent issues only — shown on the emergency contacts section of each manual.
settings.languageDescription: Choose the language for the Handover interface. This does not affect the language of individual manuals.
settings.billingDescription: Your plan determines how many manuals you can create and whether the Handover footer appears.
settings.paidPlan: Paid plan — unlimited manuals, no Handover footer
settings.freePlan: Free plan — one manual, with a small "Made with Handover" line on it.
settings.freelancerPlan: Freelancer — 3 active manuals at a time, no Handover branding.
settings.studioPlan: Studio — 10 active manuals at a time, no Handover branding.
settings.agencyPlan: Agency — unlimited manuals, no Handover branding.
settings.subscriptionNote: If a subscription ends, manuals already published stay online and readable, and the account returns to the free plan.
settings.upgradePrice: Freelancer $19/month for 3 active manuals. Studio $39/month for 10. Agency $79/month for unlimited. Billed monthly. Drafts and archived manuals are unlimited on every plan.
settings.upgradeNote: Your account is upgraded once payment clears — usually within a few hours. Email hello@handover.agency if anything looks wrong.
settings.savedDesc: Your agency branding has been updated.
edit.subtitle: Fill in the factual details — we write the professional copy for you.
edit.completion.allFilled: All fields filled — ready to share.
edit.draftWarn.title: This manual is a draft
edit.draftWarn.body: This manual is only {percent}% complete. Sharing it now means your client will see a manual with missing information. Are you sure you want to preview it?
edit.deleteSection.title: Delete section?
edit.deleteSection.body: Deleting this section will also delete all fields inside it. This cannot be undone.
edit.localeWarn.title: Change manual language?
edit.localeWarn.body: Fields that still contain the default text will be re-rendered in {locale}. Text you have already edited will not be changed.
edit.fields.registrarAccess: Who can sign in to the registrar
edit.fields.dnsAccess: Who can sign in to the DNS?
edit.fields.mailElsewhereHint: If mail is hosted elsewhere, changing nameservers can take the client's email down. Say so here.
domainOwner.option.agency: Agency owns it on the client's behalf
dnsChange.option.nameservers: We pointed the nameservers at a new host
dnsChange.option.records: We only changed records — DNS stayed where it was
public.manualNotFoundDesc: This manual may have been moved or deleted.
public.noAccounts: No accounts have been recorded yet.
secretName.blocked: Handover doesn't store passwords or keys — not even in custom fields. Record where the account lives and who owns it, and let the client hold the credential itself.
secretName.warned: If this field is for a credential, don't fill it in — record who owns the account instead.
edit.accountsMicrocopy: We never store passwords. This section records which accounts exist and who owns them. Your client keeps their own credentials — which means if Handover is ever breached, there is nothing here to steal.
edit.assetsEmpty: No files or assets recorded yet.
edit.assetUrlInvalid: Links must start with http:// or https://.
edit.assetUrlShareWarning: This looks like a share link — anyone who can open this manual can open this file. If that is not what you want, record where the file lives instead of linking to it.
settings.logoDrop: Click to upload or drop a file here
settings.logoRejection: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. SVG isn’t supported — export a PNG at 2x for a crisp logo.
settings.logoUrlHelp: Paste a direct link to your logo image (https:// only). Works well if your logo is already on a CDN.
settings.typefaceDescription: The fonts used for headings and body text on your client manuals.
settings.customFontNameError: Use letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens and underscores only (max 40 characters).
settings.customFontUrlStylesheetError: That looks like a Google Fonts stylesheet, not a font file. Choose a font from the list above, or paste a direct link to a .woff2, .woff, .otf or .ttf file.
settings.customFontUrlSchemeError: Font file URLs must start with https://.
settings.customFontUrlExtensionError: The URL must end in .woff2, .woff, .otf or .ttf.
settings.typefacePreviewBody: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
edit.sendToClientBody:
Hi,

Here is the link to your website owner's manual:
{url}

Let us know if you have any questions.
edit.contactsPrivacy: Only you can see this. These details are not shown on the manual.
maintenance.warned: This mentions a credential. Nothing here is stored as a secret, and this section is public — don't write anything you wouldn't hand to the client.
edit.maintenanceStandardHint: Twenty-one tasks a typical site needs, with a suggested owner on each. Edit, reassign or delete any of them.
public.draftBanner: Draft — only you can see this. Publish it to give your client the link.
edit.publishWarn.title: This manual is under 60% complete
edit.publishWarn.body: Publishing now means your client will see a manual with missing information. You can still publish — this is just a heads up.
manuals.copyLinkNotLive: This manual isn't published yet. Publish it first so the link works.
manuals.archivedNote: Archived manuals stay online and don't count.
manuals.liveCount: {live} of {limit} active manuals. Archived manuals stay online and don't count.
manuals.liveCountSingular: {live} of {limit} active manual. Archived manuals stay online and don't count.
manuals.liveCountUnlimited: {live} active manuals. Archived manuals stay online and don't count.
manuals.liveCountUnlimitedSingular: {live} active manual. Archived manuals stay online and don't count.
scripts.title: Client email scripts
scripts.subtitle: Ready-to-send emails for each stage of a client relationship. Pick a manual and the scripts fill in automatically.
scripts.noManualSelected: No manual selected — tokens show as placeholders. Pick a manual to fill them in.
scripts.noManualsHint: Create a manual first, then come back here to generate client emails.
scripts.copiedDesc: Subject and body are in your clipboard.
scripts.copiedBodyDesc: The email body is in your clipboard.
scripts.copyFailedDesc: Select the text manually and copy.
admin.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the agency account and all of its application data.
admin.deleteWarning: Any active manuals will go permanently offline for those agencies' clients.
admin.deleteEmailInstruction: Type the account email exactly to confirm.
admin.deleteSuccess: Deleted {manuals} manuals ({active} active). The account and login were removed.
admin.deletePartial: Deleted {manuals} manuals ({active} active) and the application data, but the login still exists because it could not be removed.
edit.archivedState: Archived · still online for your client, read-only
planLimit.title: Plan limit reached
planLimit.body: You have {n} active manuals on the {plan} plan. Archive one to publish this — an archived manual stays online for your client and becomes read-only — or move up a plan.
templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Define your agency's manual shape once. New manuals start from a template instead of the standard layout.
templates.editorDescription: Choose which sections and fields to hide, and add custom fields that every manual from this template will start with.
templates.alwaysOn: Always included — every manual needs this.
templates.deleteDescription: Manuals already built from this template are not affected.
templates.emptyDescription: Create a template to define your agency's standard manual shape.
templates.freePlanDescription: Templates are included on Freelancer, Studio and Agency. Move up a plan to define reusable manual templates.
templates.fieldsHidden: {fields} fields hidden, {sections} sections hidden, {custom} custom fields
templates.maintenanceEmpty: No maintenance tasks yet. Add one or use the standard schedule.
templates.instructionsPlaceholder: How to edit this part of the site
templates.accountsNote: Admin emails are never stored in templates — they are client-specific.
settings.templatesDescription: Define reusable shapes for your manuals.
manuals.newDialog.description: Choose a starting shape and name the client.
manuals.deleteBodyDraft: Delete this manual? This cannot be undone.
manuals.deleteBodyLive: "{name}" is active — the client's page will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
manuals.deleteConfirm: Type the client name ({name}) to confirm:
manuals.archiveBody: Archive "{name}"? The client's page stays online but becomes read-only.
manuals.saveAsTemplateDesc: Create a template from "{name}" — its shape, custom fields, maintenance schedule, coverage, edit blocks and accounts (without admin emails).
manuals.templateSavedPartial: Template saved, but some parts did not copy
manuals.newDialog.partialCopy: Manual created, but some parts did not copy
scripts.subject: Subject
scripts.deleteScriptBody: Delete this custom script? This cannot be undone.
scripts.tokenHelp: Tokens: {client_name}, {site_name}, {site_url}, {manual_url}, {support_email}. An unfilled token appears to the reader as a bracketed placeholder, not blank.
scripts.credentialWarning: This looks like it might contain a credential — Handover never stores secrets, and an email is not a safe place to send one.
scripts.noScriptsInLang: No scripts in this language yet. Create one with “New script.”
scripts.editorSourceNote: The editor shows the script’s source text. Tokens are filled in when the script is displayed and copied.
edit.signoffDescription: A record of what was handed over and when. Tick each item as it's confirmed. This is not a signature or a waiver — it records that the handover happened, not that the client agreed to anything.
edit.signoff.warned: This mentions a credential. Nothing here is stored as a secret — don't write anything you wouldn't hand to the client.
